title: Introductions, birthplace and move to Paris
summary: Interviewers introduce themselves; Merlin gives his name, birth in Bordeaux (1918) and his move to Paris art school in 1942.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Today in the Seminar Room 2 of this library here, see Howard Tilton Library, Tulane University, and today is August the 14th, 1916, and what is your name please?
Pierre Merlin, Peter Merlin. I see.
How do you spell that last name?

And I'm Dick Allen. So we want to talk to you about, a little bit about your life, and then about the music you've played, and about the music in France in general that you've heard, not just that you've played. Where were you born?
In Bordeaux, in the southeast of France. And I went in Paris in 1942 for continuing my studies in art school, in fine arts school in Paris. I see.
What year were you born in, do you mind us asking?
When? Your birth date. Birth date, 1918. June 30. I see. And ask me.
